scope: Level-three half-elf Alchemist in the existing single local campaign
rules: D&D 5e 2014 with Artificer and Alchemist from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything (2020)

inventoryPolicy.newHero: Artificer class equipment and guild artisan background equipment; no extra magic loot or free shield
inventoryPolicy.flasks: Two empty ordinary flasks bought for 4 copper from the background's 15 gold
inventoryPolicy.existingHeroes: Semantic missing-item checks, preserve existing equipment and remaining ammunition; one-time durable receipts prevent replenishment after sale or consumption
inventoryPolicy.unknownItems: Defer equipment grants until saved catalog references can be resolved

persistence.receipt: partyUpdates.alchemist20261023, stored with the campaign envelope
persistence.deletedHero: Not recreated after the addition receipt is committed
persistence.renaming: Unlimited edits of the name field preserve the stable character identity
persistence.failures: Restore characters, receipt and combat log when the durable save fails

automatedThirdLevelFeatures: Intelligence spellcasting, preparation after long rest, prepared rituals and tool or own infused-item focus
Six experimental elixirs, player-entered dice, flask accounting, slot or MP payment, action accounting, durations and creator-rest expiry
Per-instance infusions, attunement ownership, generated ammunition and returning thrown weapons
Magical Tinkering with its object limit and oldest-effect replacement
The Right Tool for the Job with an actual hour of game time and replacement of the prior created toolkit
catalogPolicy: Add 30 missing 2014-compatible spell records and Artificer membership to existing canonical spells, matching the user's verified 111-card Drive archive. New spells above the character's available circles explicitly identify unimplemented scene consequences and do not silently apply them.

availableSpellAudit.scope: Only currently available circles; scene facts and physical dice are supplied by the players or GM

driveReference.verification: Fresh HTTPS range reads of both ZIP directories and seven text records, checked by ZIP CRC32 and recorded SHA256. Both printed card orders match all 111 entries of the complete archive and its HTML reference.
driveReference.chemicalMasterySpell: Heal, available through the level-15 feature; not added to ordinary class preparation or level-three access
driveReference.archiveNameSearch: Archive names are additional searchable aliases; canonical spell IDs and custom names remain intact
mechanicsCorrections: Ray of Frost applies the entered cold damage and slows only on a hit until the caster's next turn
Snare retains its original eight-hour deadline and ends when its restrained creature is released
Faerie Fire grants its sight-dependent benefit only to an attacker able to see the target
Cure Wounds, Healing Word and Spare the Dying reject undead and constructs before spending resources
Healing Word and Poison Spray require actual target visibility, including blindness and invisibility checks
Spare the Dying sets the existing stable death-save state at zero hit points; later damage restarts dying
Create Bonfire needs visible ground but can affect unseen creatures in the cube
Fire Bolt uses entered attack and damage dice for objects and ignites only hit flammable unattended objects
Object ignition survives concentration ending and reload; the GM can confirm extinguishing with durable rollback on failed save
Catapult object damage uses the supported scene-save format and survives reload together with creature damage and the single slot payment
